tei:div.tei:p: (427) yum ka'i las tshogs g.yang sgrub tshig tho ni/

sems bskyed sdom chog nas/ yum ka'i brgyud 'debs/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun/ dkar/ bgegs bskrad/ srung byin gsum/ yum ka'i mchod brlab/ bstod pa yan zin nas/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar= sogs/ rtsa sngags stong*/ las sngags brgya/ phyag 'tshal sa gzhi= brgya/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya/ rten snying lan gsum/ las gzhung gi mchod pa/ zhi rol/ bstod pa/ yig brgya/ gsol ka dang*/ grangs ci mang bsags/ gser skyems yan/ na raka skong bshags/ yum ka'i tshogs bar bshags/ skong bshags nang*/ tshogs brgya bsag mdor na= mthar/ bse rags bkar ba/ a ka ro= lan gsum/ thing gsum/ dgu thing*/ dung*/ rkang bzhi/ dengs shig: mthar dgu thing*/ tshar bzhi 'don/ dgu thing*/ dung*/ gats+tsha: zil nang mdos bskyal/ hūm̐:snod bcud sprul pa'i= sum gcig zil nang*/ sum bha ni= rkang bzhi/ sum gnyis/ hrīḥ snang srid dag pa= sum gnyis/ hoḥ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i= sum gcig thing gsum/ zil/ rkang gsum/ rgya/ (Musical notes and signs here) dgra lha'i rdzas/ hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas= sogs sbyar/ mtshams rnams su dgu rkyang*/ dgu rkyang*/ zil/ bzhag sngags ring brgya/ thing gcig zil/ sum gnyis/ g.yang 'gugs/ sum gcig zil/ bzhag sngags brgya/ g.yang 'gugs tshar brgya/ sgrub sngags stong 'gro dgos/ tshogs drang ba/ lhag ma/ gsol ka bskyang*/ bskul/ chad brtan bro gsum/ (428) mchod bstod bshags gsum/ dngos grub zhi rol rjes/ sbyin bdag stan la 'khaud/ thing gsum/ zil/ dgu rkyang gis/ g.yang 'gugs tshar gcig zil/ sum gnyis/ ma chags sogs/ 'bab gyur cig sum gcig zil nang*/ g.yang rten rnams 'jog sar dgaud/ bzhag rol/ 'dir ni gzugs= sogs rten bzhugs bya/ las byang bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis rol chen bcas spyi ltar ro// maṅga lam//
